subject: The one mistake 90% of users make in week 2
preview_text: I wasn't going to send this, but it's the difference between healing and just surviving. The truth about your 3AM thoughts...
body_paragraphs: Okay, confession time. When I was building this app, I made one huge assumption about heartbreak. I thought the hardest part was the first 72 hours. The crying, the shock, the 'I can't eat' phase. But I was wrong. Dead wrong.

The real danger zone hits around day 10. That's when most people think they're 'getting better' because the tears slow down. But underneath? That's when the obsessive thoughts dig their claws in deep. The 'what ifs' start looping. The loneliness feels permanent. And that's exactly when 90% of users make the same critical mistake: they stop tracking their 3AM spiral patterns.

Here's the secret hack our most successful users discovered: The Emergency Mode isn't just for crisis moments. It's your early warning system. Every time you log a 3AM thought, the AI therapist learns your specific pain patterns. After just 3 entries, it starts predicting your spiral triggers 24 hours before they hit. That's 600+ users who cut their obsessive thought cycles in half by doing this one thing.

Open the app right now and tap Emergency Mode. Don't wait for the next spiral. Log what you're feeling this second—even if it's 'numb' or 'fine.' Let the AI see your pattern today so it can protect you tomorrow. P.S. The users who do this for 3 days straight report something wild: they start sleeping through the night again. Like actually sleeping.
